description: This file contains C source code implementing private wrapper functions for LAN management, including stopping scans, getting and setting LAN host comments, and retrieving Ethernet port information, with associated licensing and copyright notices.

methods.name: lm_wrapper_priv_stop_scan
methods.description: Stops LAN scan based on bridge mode settings, returns 0 or 1.

methods.name: lm_wrapper_priv_getLanHostComments
methods.description: Retrieves LAN host comments based on MAC address, extracts comment after '+' character.

methods.name: lm_wrapper_priv_set_lan_host_comments
methods.description: Sets LAN host comments for a given MAC address.

methods.name: lm_wrapper_priv_getEthernetPort
methods.description: Returns Ethernet port number for a MAC address, currently stubbed to return -1.
